scope_in: ESC ECU hardware design (Tier-1 platform + AutoSem MCU)
ESC firmware (safety-critical algorithms, diagnostics, fail-safe modes)
Functional Safety Concept (FSC) and Technical Safety Concept (TSC) for the ESC unit
Hardware and software safety verification and validation
Integration of ESC with CAN-based vehicle control network (coordinated by OEM)
ASIL D target for all safety-critical functions
scope_out: Vehicle-level HARA (owned by Phoenix Motors OEM program)
Suspension, brake, or drivetrain control logic (separate Tier-1 suppliers)
Production manufacturing and supply chain qualification (separate agreement)
Field service diagnostics and fleet monitoring tools

communication_channels.attendees: Phoenix (Rodriguez), ChassisCorp (Bergstrom + Design Lead), AutoSem (Dr. Chen)
communication_channels.escalation: Technical disagreements → Technical Lead escalation; Unresolved after 2 escalations → Program Manager decision
Red items (schedule, safety risk) trigger immediate unscheduled call

communication_channels.attendees: VP-level from each org; full design + safety teams
communication_channels.escalation: Strategic disputes (scope, timeline, cost) resolved by Steering Committee consensus

communication_channels.attendees: All parties; Phoenix has edit access for approval comments
communication_channels.escalation: Review findings tracked in system; unresolved findings block milestone gate

joint_reviews.format: Virtual; expect 6 hours of meetings over 2 days

joint_reviews.name: TSC & HW Architecture Review

joint_reviews.format: Hybrid: HW/HSI on-site Hannover (2 days), SW architecture virtual (1 day)

joint_reviews.name: FMEDA Review (System + Chip)
joint_reviews.attendees: Phoenix (Rodriguez, Diagnostics Reviewer), ChassisCorp (FMEA Lead), AutoSem (Dr. Chen, Reliability Lead)

joint_reviews.name: Safety Plan & Test Strategy Alignment
joint_reviews.attendees: Phoenix (Rodriguez, Test Lead), ChassisCorp (Bergstrom, V&V Manager, Test Lead), AutoSem (Dr. Chen, Test Coordinator)

joint_reviews.name: Safety Case Draft Review

supplier_deliverables.name: Functional Safety Concept (FSC)
supplier_deliverables.format: PDF (main document) + Excel (FTA, FMEA-style analysis tables)
supplier_deliverables.acceptance_criteria: Completes ISO 26262-4 checklist; all FSR IDs assigned; FTA nodes traceable to safety goals; no unresolved diagnostic gaps

supplier_deliverables.name: Technical Safety Concept (TSC)
supplier_deliverables.format: PDF + Excel (TSR allocation, timing budget, system FMEA)
supplier_deliverables.acceptance_criteria: Covers all FSRs; safety mechanisms mapped to TSRs; ASIL apportionment justified; timing analysis complete; zero open safety concerns

supplier_deliverables.name: Hardware Safety Requirements Specification
supplier_deliverables.acceptance_criteria: Traced to TSRs; testable; includes safe states and diagnostic thresholds; AutoSem confirms feasibility

supplier_deliverables.name: Hardware Architecture & Design Documentation
supplier_deliverables.format: PDF schematic + draw.io block diagrams + Excel BOM
supplier_deliverables.acceptance_criteria: Schematic auditable; safety barriers clearly identified; diagnostic pathways traced; PCB layout review complete

supplier_deliverables.name: Hardware-Software Interface (HSI) Specification
supplier_deliverables.format: PDF + C header files + YAML register map
supplier_deliverables.acceptance_criteria: Register layout stable; interrupt timing specified; memory-mapped safety registers protected; AutoSem datasheet cross-check complete

supplier_deliverables.name: System-Level FMEDA (Hardware)
supplier_deliverables.format: Excel (FMEA table with diagnostic coverage, ASIL allocation)
supplier_deliverables.acceptance_criteria: All components covered; failure rates sourced (Siemens SN29500 or equivalent); diagnostic latency modeled; PMHF targets met

supplier_deliverables.name: Chip-Level FMEDA & Safety Datasheet
supplier_deliverables.format: PDF (safety datasheet) + Excel (chip FMEDA, on-chip failure modes)
supplier_deliverables.acceptance_criteria: Chip-level FMEDA includes on-chip logic, memory, clock faults; diagnostic coverage for each mode; Safe initialization sequence; ChassisCorp confirms usability

supplier_deliverables.name: Software Safety Requirements Specification
supplier_deliverables.acceptance_criteria: Traced to TSRs; includes safe states, watchdog handling, mode transitions; timing assumptions explicit; zero safety-critical TBD items

supplier_deliverables.name: Software Architecture & Detailed Design
supplier_deliverables.format: C code repository (access via GitLab, read-only for Phoenix) + architecture documentation PDF
supplier_deliverables.acceptance_criteria: Code structure auditable; safety functions isolated; diagnostic code traced to FMEDA; unit test stubs present; no safety-critical dead code

supplier_deliverables.name: Software Verification Report (Unit & Integration Tests)
supplier_deliverables.format: PDF report + Excel test matrix + Code coverage report
supplier_deliverables.acceptance_criteria: MC/DC coverage ≥90% on safety-critical code; all TSRs verified; test cases traceable to requirements; zero unresolved failures

supplier_deliverables.name: Safety Plan (Joint with ChassisCorp)
supplier_deliverables.acceptance_criteria: Covers organizational roles, communication, tool qualification, configuration management, process compliance; approved by both OEM & Tier-1

supplier_deliverables.name: Subsystem Safety Case (ChassisCorp contribution to OEM Safety Case)
supplier_deliverables.format: PDF + assurance structure (drawio or Assure tool export)
supplier_deliverables.acceptance_criteria: Assurance structure maps to OEM top-level safety case; all claims substantiated; no gaps in evidence chain; accepted by OEM safety authority

supplier_deliverables.name: Chip-Level Safety Case (AutoSem contribution)
supplier_deliverables.acceptance_criteria: Demonstrates ASIL D compliance at chip level; diagnostic mechanisms proven; safe state transitions verified; integrated into subsystem case by ChassisCorp
